# PdfBuilder

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Builds a PDF document from fluent API descriptors. Returned by `Create` and provides methods to save the document.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PdfBuilder()
```

## Methods

- [`Attach`](#attach): Embeds a file into the document as an associated file (PDF/A-3 / ZUGFeRD).
- [`Build`](#build): Builds the Document from all configured page descriptors.
- [`GenerateBytes`](#generatebytes): Generates the PDF as a byte array.
- [`Page`](#page): Adds a page to the document.
- [`Save`](#save): Saves the document to the specified file path.
- [`SaveAsync`](#saveasync): Asynchronously saves the document to the specified file path.
- [`WithDefaultTextStyle`](#withdefaulttextstyle): Sets a document-wide default text style.
- [`WithMetadata`](#withmetadata): Configures document metadata (title, author, etc.).
- [`WithSettings`](#withsettings): Configures document settings (encryption, PDF/A, zoom, etc.).

### `Attach`

```csharp
PdfBuilder Attach(FileAttachment attachment)
PdfBuilder Attach(string fileName, byte[] content, AttachmentRelationship relationship = AttachmentRelationship.Unspecified, string mediaType = null)
```

Embeds a file into the document as an associated file (PDF/A-3 / ZUGFeRD). See `Attachments` for the conformance rules that govern when the file is actually written.

### `Page`

```csharp
void Page(Action<PageDescriptor> handler)
```

Adds a page to the document. If a default text style is configured (via `WithDefaultTextStyle` or `DefaultTextStyle`), it is applied to all text elements created within the handler.

```csharp

```

Asynchronously saves the document to the specified file path.

### `WithDefaultTextStyle`

```csharp
PdfBuilder WithDefaultTextStyle(Action<TextStyle> configure)
```

Sets a document-wide default text style. All text elements will inherit these defaults unless overridden by page-level `DefaultTextStyle` or element-level fluent calls.
